title: lut1d interpolation verifier — analytical checker for Scout's experiment outputs
purpose: Companion to artifact 73a5eddc-d915-4adf-bdfb-a54b8cb5f664. Provides a known-answer .cube and a Python script that checks the diff PNGs produced by run_experiment.sh for measurable properties: max pixel value, mean pixel value, and all-black detection. Converts the visual inspection step into a deterministic pass/fail check that can be run in CI or on the command line.
